# The Night Watch

*Brindle asks you to stand the night watch at the gate beside Dagny, then go down into the Outworks at dusk and hunt the gloomeyes whose eyes she sees in the dark.*

|---|---|

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Dagny 'Two-Lamps' Roe](../npcs/dagny_roe.md)
2. Defeat 20 [Gloomeye](../monsters/gloomeye.md)
